name: ai-image-router-mcp
description: Image and short-video toolkit for web projects: generation through OpenRouter, Mistral, Eden AI or fal.ai, plus local background removal, GIF assembly, icon sets, cropping and format conversion.

AIR_MCP_CONFIG.title: Path to config.json (optional)
AIR_MCP_CONFIG.description: Absolute path to a config.json made by the setup wizard (npx -p ai-image-router-mcp ai-image-router-mcp-configure). Leave empty to use ~/.ai-image-router-mcp/config.json.

AIR_MCP_HOME.title: Data directory (optional)
AIR_MCP_HOME.description: Where config, token files, downloaded models, logs and generated media are kept. Leave empty to use ~/.ai-image-router-mcp.
